name: J55 Prime
summary: Office-friendly full-colour 3D printer with high fidelity and tactile finishes.

page.description: Stratasys J55 Prime 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Possibilities
page.lead: An office-friendly full-colour PolyJet printer: up to five materials, Pantone Verified colours, textures and transparency, quiet enough for the design studio.
page.footnote: † Stratasys claim (“nearly 640,000”). Source: stratasys.com J55 Prime page, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: Colour, texture and clarity in the office.

features.title: Multi-material
features.text: Tactile and sensory finishes in one print.

features.title: Texture
features.text: Wood to fabric textures with less post-processing.

features.title: Colour
features.text: Multi-colour finishes with Pantone Verified colours.

features.title: Clarity
features.text: Transparent materials in a range of tints.

features.title: Quiet and odour-free
features.text: Under 53 dB with the ProAero air extractor (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: High capacity
benefits.text: A large rotating tray for its footprint.

specs.label: Build size
specs.value: Round print tray up to 1,174 cm²; print height 190 mm

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: Under 100 mm: ±150 µm. Over 100 mm: ±0.15 % of part length (rigid materials, 1σ)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: ToughONE, Vero, VeroVivid, VeroUltra, VeroUltra Clear, Elastico, Digital ABS Plus, DraftGrey

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE, FCC, EAC, cTUVus, CB, RCM

page.applications_heading: Realistic design models at your desk.
